Uses the authors' own snp500.csv (494 full-history S&P 500 members), the exact train 2018-2020 / test 2021 split, 120-trading-day horizon, K=20, long-only, full investment, rf=3%. Signal + solver are substituted (our MASTER/TFT/PatchTST mu + PSO/SA vs their LSTM mu + Gurobi/CardNN); objective is our mean-variance P-tradeoff, NOT their max-Sharpe. Reported OOS metric is realized annualized Sharpe (mu-rf)/sigma computed Wang-style from daily realized portfolio returns, so it is directly comparable to their Table 3 / Fig 5. NOT an exact-objective replication.
